recipe.name: The Slow Sundown
recipe.description: A rich tropical cocktail combining bright citrus and bitter orange with velvety brown butter and earthy dark rum notes.
steps: Combine Bacardi Carta Blanca, Aperol, dark rum, fresh pineapple juice, melted brown butter, and fresh lime juice in a shaker.
Dry shake vigorously without ice to emulsify the brown butter with the liquids.
Fill the shaker with ice cubes and shake hard until thoroughly chilled.
Double strain through a fine mesh strainer into a chilled coupe glass.
recipe.serving: Served straight up in a chilled coupe glass
